summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a routine Form 6-K containing two exhibits: a PDMR notification dated 13 October 2026 and a 28 October 2026 update on Chair external appointments. The PDMR notice discloses small acquisitions of BP ordinary shares ($0.25 nominal) by executives Kate Thomson (CFO), Gordon Birrell, Sam Skerry and Michael Sosso through the BP ShareMatch UK Plan at GBP 5.863 per share on 12 October 2026, outside a trading venue. No corporate transaction, stake, premium, advisor or regulatory clock is involved; this is ordinary insider-dealing disclosure plus a governance housekeeping note, with no risk-arb angle.
